text: The subject is Hina Yousaf, who holds account PK**HABB****7792 opened on 4 December 2020. The subject declared an occupation of Student with a monthly income of PKR 25,000 per month. Between 2 May 2026 and 11 May 2026, the account recorded 19 credits totalling PKR 979,000 and 4 debits totalling PKR 850,000. The credits consisted of 19 interbank (IBFT) transfers received from 15 distinct senders. An alert was raised by Tazama on 11 May 2026, where Tazama typology MULE-01 scored 360 against an alert threshold of 300. The receipt of funds from 15 distinct senders is indicative of money mule activity. Debits equal to 87% of credits, with a median of 9.6 hours between the latest credit and each debit, are consistent with suspected money mule activity. Credits in the activity window were 39.2 times the declared monthly income of PKR 25,000 per month for a Student, which is inconsistent with the customer profile and indicative of money mule activity. The note by Fraud Desk (10 May 2026) stating that two sender banks raised fraud recall requests against inbound transfers to this account, citing scam complaints, is consistent with suspected money mule activity. The activity, where credits were 39.2 times the declared monthly income of PKR 25,000 per month for a Student and involved 15 distinct senders, is consistent with suspected money mule activity. PKR 572,000 was sent to QuickPay wallet ***0932 (WLT****0932, Synthetic EMI) in 3 transactions. PKR 278,000 was withdrawn as Cash (ATM) in 1 transaction. There was no match on sanctions, PEP or adverse-media screening on 29 May 2026. The note by L2 analyst (12 May 2026) indicates that outgoing wallet transfers were placed on hold pending review.
